args.reason: The supersession argument is sound. The old decision's own rationale (fewer than 20 issues per run, simplicity) no longer holds: runs now admit 200+ issues and the concurrency executor writes many issues in parallel. The new design addresses two concrete failure modes, lock contention on one file and a single corrupt write losing the whole run's state, and keeps the same directory root with an index file for discovery. Residual risk to verify at build time: the index file is itself a single shared file, so its writes need to stay rare and atomic.
